tools.name: fan-fitter-20261012.json
tools.description: Add the supplied fan variants to both hands using reviewed placement templates, preserve distinct stock materials, and keep one active choice per hand. Includes the revised RGB material workflow; verify the saved scene and visible result in Unity.
tools.command_template: Install the reviewed editor source set described in docs/avatar-effects-editor-tools-20261012.md; then open Tools/Unity Unicorn/fan-fitter.
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the intended avatar project and its legitimately acquired asset dependencies.
Review the source and keep a recoverable project baseline before applying changes.
limitations: Editor source preview; standalone compilation is not Unity or VRChat runtime verification.
Private learned templates, third-party assets and actual use records are not bundled.
